exclusion_policy: Only accepted rows from these reviewed sources, and no unreviewed cross-source cognacy payloads. All other sources excluded from this particular collection regardless of whether their terms are missing, restrictive or simply not yet reviewed. No blanket terms assessment for the whole explorer.
